subject: Trading
title: The Future of Commodity Trading
description: A quick, practical guide to The Future of Commodity Trading.

hook.text: Carbon credits, water futures, and critical minerals—the next generation of commodities is already being traded.

buildup.text: Water futures launched on the CME in 2020. California water prices became a tradeable asset for the first time.

discovery.text: Carbon emission permits trade like commodities in Europe. Polluters must buy credits, creating a price on pollution.

twist.text: Critical minerals for batteries and chips are becoming strategic commodities—nations stockpile them like oil.

climax.text: Commodity markets are expanding to price what was once free: clean air, fresh water, and a stable climate.

punchline.text: If it's scarce and valuable, it'll eventually trade.

quiz.question: What new commodity began trading on the CME in 2020?
